vibrancy.config.blockLights.brightness.p: Linear multiplier for the brightness of all block lights. Does not affect their radius.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.entityShadow: Whether block lights cast entity shadows.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.raytraceDist: The radius (in chunks) from the camera where block lights will cast shadows.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.lightCullDis: The radius (in chunks) from the camera where block lights will be visible.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.shadowRadius: The radius (in blocks) from each block light where blocks will cast shadows.
The maximum number of block lights that will be rendered, closest lights first.
vibrancy.config.blockLights.maxRaytraced: The maximum number of block lights that will cast shadows, closest lights first.
vibrancy.config.forNerds.prefix: Options you shouldn't mess with unless you know how the mod works.
